title: Elon Musk, Sam Altman, and the Misreading of Science Fiction
summary: Adams, a comedy writer who had earlier written for Monty Python’s Flying Circus , loathed science fiction—he once said Asimov’s books read like “junk mail.” In the middle of the 1970s, Adams wrote The Hitchhiker’s Guide for BBC Radio 4.
